 Heroes gain "Soul Energy" through adventures in the park. Each assist consumes a portion of this energy.

notes.title: Happy 2025 & Patch in Progress
notes.content:
It’s a New Year~!
Happy 2025 to all park managers! Wishing everyone a fresh start and plenty of happiness discovering games you love~~

Since the release of version 0.8.5, we’ve received a lot of feedback from players regarding the gameplay and issues within the game. Due to the significant adjustments made to the overall gameplay, some severe problems have arisen, causing inconvenience to your gaming experience. We sincerely apologize for this. Over the past ten days, we’ve released a series of small updates to address the most critical issues. We are still fully dedicated to fixing bugs and fine-tuning gameplay and numerical adjustments. In addition to the issues that have already been fixed, here are the ones we’ve identified and are currently working on:

· Abnormal Pupu statuses and building states (queue freeze) caused by the hosting feature after activating the Tower of Diligence: some identified causes have been fixed, and debugging is ongoing for the remaining cases.

· Late-game save file loss: this issue has been traced to functions related to the transformation buildings of the Tower of Wisdom. Repairs and testing are underway. If you encounter abnormalities in the save menu, please avoid repeated saving to prevent further loss. We will release an update soon to resolve this, allowing saves and loads to work properly again.

· Abnormalities in some hero tent/hero hotel commission progress: this issue is currently being tested and fixed step by step.

If you experience any of the above issues or other anomalies, please use the “Report Issue” function in the game to submit your save file. This will greatly help us locate and resolve the problems. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: 0.8.5.1 Version Update Notes
notes.content:
Ta-da! The major update we previously mentioned is here!!
Since this update involves extensive low-level code reconstruction, previous version save files will no longer be compatible.
[previewyoutube=JzfFLAu3ZWQ;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Here are the specific update details:

💻 Gameplay System Adjustments

· Added the Adventure Journey feature, allowing adventurers of different identities to be assigned goals, sequences, and paths.

· Identity Summoning adjustment: Summoned identities can now be adjusted at the summoning circle anytime.

· Rent Payment System adjustment: At the beginning of each month, Joy Crystals from the previous month are automatically collected as rent payment. Any excess is returned as Goblin Coins, with fluctuations based on satisfaction during collection.

· Added the Goblin Shop: During rent collection each month, Goblin Coins can be used to purchase resources.

· Tower of Diligence adjustments: Removed the Public Dormitory feature. When the Tower of Diligence is activated, all idle Pipi in the nest automatically enter Hosting mode and will independently work at assigned buildings in hosting mode. The Exclusive Dormitory feature remains unchanged.

· Tower of Wisdom adjustments: Added the Energy mechanism. The fixed level-to-transformation-building relationship has been removed. Players can now freely choose unlocked transformation buildings within the energy limit.

· Challenge System adjustment: Removed the random trigger mechanism. Instead, three challenges will now remain constant in the park, updated at fixed intervals. Players can spend specific resources to take them on voluntarily.

· Adventure Building adjustments: Pipi can be assigned to work at buildings below their level, but this will consume additional stamina.

· Adjustment to adventurers’ Go to Room feature: When assigning adventurers to change their destination building, players can directly select the adventure goal to be executed at that building.

· Expand Land Plot adjustment: The expansion system now uses smaller land plots for more granular control.

· Swap Box adjustment: Now supports manual configuration of item types available for swapping.

💻 Logic Adjustments

· Optimized room queuing logic and adjusted capacity limits.

· Adjusted adventurer satisfaction calculation: Satisfaction is now determined solely by the number of preferences (smiles) obtained during an adventure. Wishes and commissions no longer affect satisfaction.

· Overall adjustment to adventurer logic: Adventurers now follow designated adventure paths.

· Adjusted logic for adventurers gaining gold and enhancing combat power.

· Adjusted adventurers’ pathfinding mechanisms for wish- and commission-type adventures.

· Adjusted logic for adventurers’ selling activities.

💬 Content Adjustments

· Revised building storylines, interaction requirements, and outputs based on the new commission, wish, and adventure path features.

· Adjusted adventurer identity preference types and adventure item categories.

· Adjusted Challenge content, rewards, and added difficulty tiers for progressive challenges.

· Added Development Points-related building technologies.

· Adjusted Policy Card effects.

· Revised tutorial steps and content, including guidance on Policy Cards, Challenges, and other features.

· Updated content in the manual.

🎨 UI Display & Operation Adjustments

· Dragging operation adjustments: While constructing buildings or assigning adventurers to rooms, players can now drag the map with the right mouse button without exiting the current operation.

· Main page UI layout adjustments: Combined the timeline and calendar while adding a “Rent Estimate” feature.

· Adjusted the adventurer identity summoning interface to integrate assignment operations and identity information display.

· Revamped the building information interface, dividing it into three tabs: Basic Info, Building Technology, and Storyline.

· Rearranged tabs in the Commission Board by region based on unlocked buildings.

· Added new tooltips for clarity.

In this update, we bring everyone brand new park facilities of "the royal city" region, commissions, and a hero from "Research Story" – Vallee!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
After a month of hard work, we are determined not to delay and bring you a new version before the holiday! 

Version 0.8.3, "Under the Volcano" is scheduled to be released on February 6th! We hope it adds some heat to your Chinese New Year! 🔥🧨

In the 0.8.3 version, we've introduced a brand new map: the Volcanic Terrain. Once you've successfully upgraded your Spring of Life to level 12, proving your excellent survival skills, it's time for your skilled PuPu to embark on more challenging adventures in the fiery Volcanic Terrain!
When you meet the requirements, you'll be able to select the "Volcanic Terrain" option in the land rental menu to start a new game in this thrilling environment. The entire map is covered in ash and darkness, with rocky outcrops, crevices, and lava flows. There are also several active volcanic vents.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/cbf8d5fb477dee96dbf0d080ab2bf4e2827f99f3.gif

In the Volcanic Terrain, you'll experience a new weather: Volcanic Eruption. During a volcanic eruption, your park will face various challenges. Some PuPu (like Water PuPu) will lose vitality rapidly due to the high temperatures, while others (like Fire PuPu) will feel incredibly lively and spirited. Your adventueres will also sweat more in the heat, so be prepared to catch those sweat droplets!
Additionally, near the volcanic vents, scorching lava may spill out and turn into rocks once it cools down. This can block paths or dirty up decorations, so you'll need to clean up accordingly.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/9e06354a6ca42692746ac8df28bae506d50e9faf.gif

In this harsh environment, you may also encounter Acid Rain weather. Under acid rain, constructing various facilities becomes more challenging, and heroes are more susceptible to injury due to the corrosive rain.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/a2ca676bf0792f99e1e0428364b37bcdc9d2dcec.gif

Apart from the heroes who provide powerful Gem abilities, other heroes will vary based on the map. 
In this update, the Volcanic map introduces three new heroes: Catgirl Nicole, Savage Esta, and Chieftain Romdo, along with their unique tent/lodge commissions. Nicole excels at fishing, Romdo is passionate about teaching enemies and protecting the weak, and Esta prefers to stay close to nature. How you utilize these heroes and commissions to enhance your park's development is up to you!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/554ab621ca18ad93c7abc7d4c7b1d9ffecc92024.gif

In this update, we've also added new guestroom appearances for different heroes in the hero hotel. You can unlock these appearances by activating their journal stories.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/9d3d7223bf35dba8b0560e1a6a978a0e01fc74dd.png

Furthermore, the Stone City's building technologies have been expanded! In addition to some common effects, we've added effects that increase PuPu experience gain and provide extra experience for adventure identities.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/a739bf1af0bdc6c0f8485564a2342611bbaabefd.gif

To meet you all before the Chinese New Year, we've been working day and night on this version. After the holiday, we'll continue to update and refine terrain, hero-related content, and gameplay. Different maps will offer various challenges, and you'll have more strategic options to overcome terrain and seasonal challenges using different policy cards.
We're also working on hero skills that will directly impact park management, allowing heroes to play a more direct role in managing the park rather than just performing commissions at various buildings. In addition, while implementing new maps, we've encountered some challenging technical issues. Currently, there may be some lag during map generation and placement due to the instant calculation load. We're actively seeking solutions to make the gameplay smoother.

We hope you enjoy these new contents, and we look forward to bringing you even more exciting content in the future!

Thank you all for your care and support for PuPu‘s Adventure Park this year. We hope that in the new year, we can polish the game even better and transition smoothly to the next stage! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/1ccab51491431b14c4e8037b46293f2dedf37617.png

notes.title: Ver. 0.8.2 : Creation Gem and Tower of Creation
notes.content:
The long-awaited "Power of Creation" version is finally here after months of intense development!!!
 In this version, PiPi summon a new hero - Tuyang, obtain the gem, imbued with the power of creation, and with the help of PuPu God, recreate some strange decorations. Come and explore!

Before diving into the version details, we regret to announce  that, due to some uncontrollable factors, we will be concluding our collaboration with Pixmain in terms of game publishing. We appreciate the support and hard work from Pixmain's team over the past two years! Meanwhile, due to the absence of related resources, the translation of newly added text content in the game will temporarily use machine translation and adjustments within our capabilities. We are contacting translation companies to resolve this issue as soon as possible.

Now, let's take a look at some significant parts of this update:
Decoration System:
The highly anticipated decoration system is here! Players can now build decorations in the park or lay decorative floors. Initially, players can construct some default unlocked decorations, and materials for construction are obtained by "weeding" weeds on the field. We have adjusted the logic for generating initial maps, allowing players to choose initial maps with more trees, more weeds, or higher rent according to their preferences.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/b0d38dd3442a70552d1302a24947aa4318386978.png
As the game progresses, with the activation of the "Tower of Creation," imaginative PiPi can design more decorations based on unique items dropped by heroes.
Additionally, with the upgrade of the Spring of Life and the return of the power of "Creation Gems" by PuPu God, the PuPu clan has finally recalled their unique technique of crafting "Essence" into "Bricks." With this technique, various items designed by PiPi can be mass-produced!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/03210cc3bcd0ddcf706c43e6bb5dcb375fc62650.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/e319311c538f1b8cd79a2aaaf115c56eb6a363d1.png

About Heroes and Hero Inn:
In terms of heroes, a new hero named "Tuyang" with the mission of "collecting and protecting patterns" has been added. Tuyang is a somewhat faded, abandoned paper doll who, upon arriving on the Meoster planet, developed a strong interest in patterns deposited by various civilizations. Her exclusive commission, "Authentic St. D Style Decor" involves collecting patterns from various places, and completing it allows players to obtain "Creation Gems" imbued with the power of creation.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/775b0f859df88ccb2277cabdaa5692404c79b918.png
We received feedback about the inconvenience of hero commissions and made overall adjustments to the goals, reward display, and completion mechanism of hero commissions, aiming to improve the gaming experience when handling hero commissions.
Furthermore, we modified the mechanism of commissions appearing in the Hero Inn. Currently, when a hero completes a unique commission and enters the inn, the commission carried in their tent will be published in the inn. Players need to recruit more heroes to unlock these commissions. Some heroes will receive additional rewards when completing specific commissions!

About Adventurers and Park Planning:
We have significantly modified the unlocking and summoning mechanisms for regular adventurers. In the new version, players need to spend Goblin Coins or complete specific conditions to unlock new identities. Different identity adventurers will have independent cooldown intervals for summoning, and players can freely adjust them at any time. Plan more suitable summoning intervals for them based on identity commissions, wish completion, and park planning.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/22e82551ec74cd0742501910ea52e81039620890.png

A Little Gameplay Element:
During a casual chat, we came up with a new interaction for combat-type buildings – a "poke, poke, poke" action. This action can help some clumsy adventurers fight faster and safer, and it can also pass the time during waiting in the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/33c69a188c16f7c4c7f244454731b2f78c71e118.png

Also, we recently updated the game's development roadmap, adding a module roadmap section to provide a more visual display of our update plans in different game modules. These plans will be adjusted with the progress of game development and player feedback, with the overall goal of making the game more reasonable, enjoyable, and user-friendly.The new roadmap has been updated to the in-game store page for everyone to check at any time!

Detailed Update Content for the Version:
●New System Additions:
★All-New Tower: Tower of Creation
-After upgrading the Fountain of Life to level 16 and obtaining the corresponding gem fragments, you can restore and use the Tower of Creation.
-Design and view blueprints for decorations in the Tower of Creation.
-Introduces new hero drop items, resource conversion methods, and more related to the Tower of Creation gameplay.
★Fountain of Life Level Upgrades 
-Visual changes: The PuPu God, with the new power of gems, has regained the wand.
-Attribute improvements:  Higher chances of obtaining higher-level attributes.
-Unlocks a new resource building, Essence Forge, in the corresponding PuPu Nest.
★Summoning Array
-Visual changes:  Entirely new appearance.
-Functional adjustments: Each unlocked position has an independent summoning interval.
-Adjusted the independent summoning intervals for all heroes.
★Map Generation and Weed Dropping
-When selecting the initial map, there is now greater variation in the proportion of randomly generated trees and weeds, as well as larger variations in initial rent.
-Weeding now drops two exclusive materials, which will be used in the construction of initial decorations.
(If all plants have been cleared in an old save, exclusive materials cannot be obtained currently.)
★Hero Unlocks and Levels
-In the new game after the update, hero identities have been phased, requiring conditions to unlock identities that are initially unused.
-The maximum level of heroes has been increased to level 5, with the addition of new wishes and a reassignment of wishes according to level.
★Storyline Unlocks
-Adjusted the unlocking method for 4th tier weapons and 4th tier armor storylines; now, heroes need to complete specific commissions to add new storylines to interactive buildings.
-The Military Camp Kitchen has added a new strengthening item storyline, also requiring heroes to complete specific commissions (currently, heroes do not actively seek strengthening items, and this will be optimized in the future).
★Hero Commission Unlocks
-Adjusted the appearance rules for commissions available in the Inn; when heroes settle in the Inn, their commissions will appear in the Inn and can be assigned to other heroes after they are acquired.
-Overall adjustments to the resource drops for Inn commissions.
★"God Mode" (After PuPu God's [Careful] Consideration)
-PuPu God found that some battles might be difficult for heroes, so you can now click on PuPu during battles to lower the difficulty.
-Completely free with no consumption; thanks to PuPu God!

●Game Content Additions:
★New buildings: 
-Enchanted Park Building , 
-PuPu Nest Resource Building .
★New Park Decorations: 36 items,
★New floor Decorations: 4 items.
★New Commissions on the Commission Board :  "Legend of Yellow Old Cake" and "Power of the Masses".
★New Hero Identity , with 3 new hero commissions: "Stylish Decoration in the Underground", "Transforming Decay into Magic", "Advanced Armor".
★New Inn Commissions :  "Carved in Stone", "Forgotten Corner", "Advanced Weapon".

●UI and Display Optimization:
★Improved the text display of activation progress in the tent and Inn commissions, now showing all items that support unlocking progress.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Long time no see! It's been a month since our last update! Today, we bring you some recent game development updates and adjustments!
Version 0.8.2 is the second major update since Early Access began. The game will focus on the Tower of Creation and the Park Decoration system for a series of gameplay and content updates.
In this version, the game will include two types of decorations: regular decorations and floor decorations. Players often hesitated to cut down the pink cherry blossom tree, and the PiPi found a way to let everyone keep it (with a slight twist).

notes.title: 0.8.1.0 Version Update Notes
notes.content:
Hi, sorry that the English version of patch notes was not available for a while…We’ll try to keep up in the future!!

So, in this update, we changed and polished a lot of things…
It's been two months since we released the game as early access and thank you for everyone's feedback and support during this time!
 
In this update, in addition to the planned addition of new buildings and new identities in Swamp City, some adjustments and additions have been made to the game’s mechanics and cycles. The specific content is as follows:
 
New Game System (Important! Affects Blueprint Unlock mechanics)
First, introduce [Development Points], and now you will need this to unlock Park Blueprints, but not [Wish Fragments] anymore!
 
★ Adjusted the building technology system functions. Building technology types are divided into two categories: permanently unlocked and repeat activation.
- For Permanently unlock techs: Once it’s unlocked, it can be applied to all the same buildings, and you can get [Development Points] after unlocking one.
- For repeat activation techs: You will consume tech points when you activate them, but you can't get [Development Points] from this kind of tech.
 
★ Adjusted resource output and consumption related to Blueprints and building systems
- As mentioned at the beginning, "Wish Fragments" has been cancelled. And [Development Points] are needed to expand the blueprint.
 
★ Reconstructed the building status and optimized the situation where the stuck building cannot be entered for unknown reasons.
(If you still encounter related problems, please click "Contact Us" in the game to report the situation. Thank you!!!!! )
 
★Adventurers are removed from the blueprint; they are all “unlocked” now, but you will have to summon them wisely according to the essence you might need.
 
New Game content
★Added three new buildings in : the Periphery of Swamp City (Battle), the Historical Sites of Swamp City (Exploration), and the Fish Pond (Exploration)
 
★New commissions for : Exploring ruins, a bowl of hot soup, lazy soldiers, fish!...fish??, the chef and his kitchen
 
★Added new adventurer identity 
- 5 related adventurers' wishes: Waves in the swamp, treasure map, ruins and treasures, fountain of youth, preparation for going to sea
 
★Added a new  commission to improve the early construction experience of Wasteland Village
 
★New technology and the appearance of Wasteland Village have been added, and some default effects triggered by the chance of some buildings are added.
 

 "Wild Wasteland" The default wind and sand effect will affect adventurers' battle, and appearance upgrades, and improve PuPu work efficiency.
 "Sand Maze" The default wind and sand effect will affect adventurers' battles, appearance upgrades, drop additional building materials, and unique building effects.
 "Central Square" appearance upgrade, get extra BUFF, and improve PuPu work efficiency.
 "Street Corner" The default money-stealing effect will reduce the gold coins held by the adventurer, appearance upgrade, obtain additional BUFF, and improve PuPu work efficiency.
 "Normal House" appearance upgrade, exclusive kitten technology, adventurers rest, and additional BUFFs
 "Abandoned Mine" The default stun effect extends adventure interaction time, appearance upgrades, and drops additional materials
 "Deep in the Sand" The default ground stab effect will deal damage to the adventurer’s HP, appearance upgrade, drop additional materials, and have unique building-specific effects
 "Simple Pharmacy" The default effect will reduce a certain percentage of the hero's blood recovery effect and appearance upgrade, have a higher discount, and have unique building-specific effects.
 "Tailor Shop"&"Weapon Shop" appearance upgrade, higher discounts, and unique building-specific effects

 
★The building effects and technologies outside Wasteland Village have not been updated and will be updated in batches in subsequent versions.
 
New Interface UI and display
 
★Weeding
- Plants that can be cleared will have icon prompts
- The selected plant outline has a new color change
 
★Pay rent

★New player experience optimization
-  New tutorial added for new players: must learn to build a path between the summoning machine and the building at the beginning.
-Click [Missing PuPu] to quickly open the list of PuPu that can be assigned.
-Click [Road can’t go through] to quickly open the road building mode.
 
★Manual assignment
-When assigning an adventurer to a building, the storyline related to the commission or wish in the building will now be given priority.
 
★Game tutorial
-Instructions for relevant in-game mechanisms have been added to the upper right corner of the game. You can check the brief introduction to some of the current game mechanics.
(Content continues to be added, and translation is still polishing!!! Feedback on related questions and information is welcome!)
 
Other tiny optimizations
- Added text stroke and word-jumping animations to HP consumption when Adventurers and Pupu fight.
- You can now assign missions to adventurers on the mission board.
- Adjusted the UI and prompt display related to building technology
- The pause and start of Summoning Adventurers are set to permanent display
- Optimized the display style of confirmation and cancellation related to mouse guidance in the construction function
 
BUG Fix
1. Display

2. Logic

notes.title: Release Date Announcement and Game Content Details
notes.content:
Hi everyone, it's finally the day!

PuPu's Adventure Park will be launched in the form of EA on 7/18 at 7:30 pm PDT! 

We've added and improved a lot of things in this EA version. It should now offer at least 10-15 hours of gameplay compared to the DEMO. The standout new feature is the Obelisk, which adds more depth to the heroes' storyline. Since they play a crucial role in helping PiPi (meaning multiple PuPu) unlock new towers, we gave them a special area to reside in.

In terms of the blueprint (areas & facilities) and game content, the game will cover four primary areas, including Wasteland Village, Stone City, Dense Forest, and Swamp City. Additionally, we've added four new adventurer types: Alchemist, Librarian, Botanist, and Barbaric Warriors. As a result, the game will now offer a richer storyline, complete with exciting missions and engaging dialogues.

We have a clear development plan for the game after the EA release, which will include 
- Three new park terrains, 
- Two towers with different functionalities, 
- New stories until the end of the main plot (the comic!),
- Additionally, we plan to add more adventurer types, along with corresponding missions and stories, to make the game more diverse and richer in terms of replay value.  
We welcome any feedback or suggestions you may have on how to make the game more fun. Please don't hesitate to share your thoughts with us on Discord.

And if you are a content creator or press who would like to have an advance access to the game, please fill this form, and we will contact you directly for details. :)

We hope you enjoy PuPu's Adventure Park. Thanks for your support ❤️. See you soon next week!

notes.title: Welcome to PuPu's Adventure Park!
notes.content:
Hi there! 
Welcome to PuPu's Adventure Park! We are Plum Tree Games, an indie team from Beijing (where yummy Peking Duck comes from), and this is our studio's first ever game！ 

There's so much we'd like to share with you all (game concept, dev story, etc.), but as this is our first community post and as the game will soon be attending Next Fest, we've decided to focus on introducing a bit more about how gameplay works and what you'll be able to do in the demo. :)

PuPu's Adventure Park is a management simulation game where you play as both the park manager and the leader of the PuPu clan. There are two primary goals:
- First, manage and expand your adventure park, satisfy your guests (adventurers who are summoned from other worlds), and (secretly) gather resources from their "adventure experience".
- Second, grow the PuPu clan and (hopefully) break free from the Dark Goblin's control.  

Upon starting the game, you'll discover that the adventure park is quite unusual! It's been designed to provide guests with a full "RPG" adventure experience and to fulfill their "wishes".  Once you've gained enough resources to expand the park blueprint, you can begin building even wilder park facilities designed to provide a more thrilling experience for your guests, enabling them to eventually complete their full "RPG story".

Our upcoming demo includes...
- Two areas of the first park, containing 21 different facilities and NPC roles (played by our park "staff")
- Encounter 8 kinds of adventurers (our name for park guests!) and 2 special heroes
- 6 different policy cards to improve your running of the park, and random case/challenges that suddenly appear, causing accidents :P
- Two chapters of the PuPu clan story, as well as 13 kinds of buildings (and secret relics) that help you grow the PuPu clan's home.
 Plus some surprises for you to discover on your own! 

Finally...there's quite a lot text in the game, and we know that the current state of the English translation has some room for improvement. However, we hope that this won't impact your gaming experience. ;)

There's lots of content and gameplay still in development, and you're welcome to leave any feedback and suggestions regarding how we can further improve the experience!
If you are interested in our game, please wishlist and follow to receive the latest updates, and feel free to jump into our discord channel for a chat too!
